description.value:
Gungans are an amphibious humanoid species native to the swamps and seas of Naboo, having built vast underwater cities long before their surface-dwelling human neighbors knew they existed. Gungans possess long, prehensile ears, wide mouths, and eyes on stalks that grant them near-360-degree vision, all adaptations to a life spent both above and below the waterline.

Gungan culture blends primitive-seeming customs with genuinely advanced hydrostatic technology, and Gungans who venture into the wider galaxy often surprise those who underestimate them.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: You can breathe both air and water.

traits.name: Bombad Reflexes
traits.description: Your eye-stalks grant you nearly all-around vision. You have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to notice a creature attempting to sneak up on you from outside your normal field of vision.

traits.name: Swimmer
traits.description: You have a swimming speed of 30 feet.
